name: App shell
desc: A notes app: a burger that folds the page rail to icons, a brand, a list of notes and a rich editor that fill the window, notes kept as Markdown files, and settings that are remembered.
settings:
theme | dark | choice | Theme | dark,light
startup | 0 | startup | Start with Windows

windows.name: Main
windows.title: Notes
windows.menus:
&File
    &New note | Ctrl+N | NewNote()
    &Delete the note | | DeleteNote()
    -
    E&xit | Alt+F4 | g.Close()
&View
    &Names and icons | | g.NavMode("full")
    &Icons only | | g.NavMode("compact")
windows.status:
msg | Ready | grow icon=E70B
count | 0 notes | w=110 right
windows.titleitems:
menu | burger | | tip="Show or hide the names" class=morph toggle | g.NavMode("toggle")
brand | text | Notes |
gap | spacer | |
new | glyph | E710 | right tip="New note (Ctrl+N)" | NewNote()
acct | glyph | E77B | right tip="Account"
windows.flows:
newBtn Click -> call NewNote
delBtn Click -> call DeleteNote

props.placeholder: Pick a note, or start a new one with Ctrl+N.

kids.arg: Each note is a Markdown file in the notes folder beside the program.

props.desc: Open Notes when you sign in
Plain Markdown files: back them up, sync them, open them anywhere

kids.arg: The burger folds the page rail to its icons. The editor is the library's rich text control: Markdown as you type, a / menu, tables, find and replace.
